\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \mu_{k^*},
\qquad
k^* = \operatorname*{arg\,min}_{k \in \{1,2,3,4\}} \sigma_k^2
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(\mu_k\): The mean of quadrant k
- \(\sigma_k^2\): The variance of the luma in quadrant k
- \(a\): Half the window size, (size - 1) / 2

The window of side 2a + 1 is split into four squares of side a + 1, the top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right quadrants. Each one holds the center pixel. mu_k and sigma_k squared are the mean and variance of quadrant k. The output is the mean of the quadrant with the smallest variance. On a tie, the first quadrant in that order wins.
